claims.statement: Tom Allen said there would be no more fighting until the stakes of the last fight were given up.
claims.excerpt: Allen said to us that there would be no more fighting until the stakes of the last fight were given up.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said the referee had made no final decision and that none was needed, because Gallagher's second threw up the sponge.
claims.excerpt: He.says the final decision of the referee has not been made, and claims that no decision is required

claims.statement: Tom Allen said a scar under his left eye was made by a blow from a club thrown into the ring during the fight with Gallagher.
claims.excerpt: there is a scar under his left eye, which-he says was made by a blow from a club thrown into the ring during the progress of the fight

claims.statement: Charley Gallagher wanted to add about $1,000 to the stakes and fight Allen again after Allen and McCoole settled their dispute.
claims.excerpt: wants to add a thousand or soto the amount, and fight the battle over, after Allen and McCoole have settled their little dispute

claims.statement: A fight between Tom Allen and Mike McCoole was expected in November 1869, though doubtful.
claims.excerpt: before the affair between Allen and McCoole in November.

notes: No new bouts. Allen's statements are the paper's paraphrase, not direct quotes, so no quotes are recorded. Hints checked and kept.
